author: Unreal Engine
description: Join us for a live walkthrough of the latest performance tooling updates in UEFN. We'll show you how the new Monitor Performance option makes it easier to keep tabs on your island's memory usage without interrupting your workflow — including real-time status indicators and alerts right in the editor. We'll also demo the new Memory Snapshot panel, which breaks down exactly which assets are eating your memory budget and links them directly to the actors in your scene. If you've ever hit a memory warning and wondered where to start, this one's for you.
title: New in 41.00: Memory Profiling for UEFN | Creating in Fortnite
